title: Wording suggestion
intro: You get a wording you can change as you like. Nothing is used until you press “Use this text”.
sent: We send only the kind of occasion, the tone, the language and the names written in the form. Never the guest list, contacts or addresses.
resultLabel: The suggestion — you can edit it
off: Wording suggestions are not switched on for this platform.
keptLabel: The text carries the “AI-generated” label until you rewrite most of it.
